sources.description: Retail listings of the HQProp Duct-T90MMX3 read on 2026-11-08 (for example getfpv.com and flyingtech.co.uk): 90 mm, pitch 3 inch, 3 blades, 2.35 g, hub 11 mm; the stakeholder named the propeller HQ DT90, whose blade count is assumed to be three.

applicability: No blade geometry: a derived BET geometry rests on its listed assumptions; ducted in the aircraft, which the model does not represent.
